readout_other: white blood cell, neutrophil and lymphocyte counts (Hemavet 950 hematology analyzer) in lymph nodes, liver, spleen and lymphatic fluid
direction_notes: Ultrasound neurostimulation directly above the popliteal lymph node produced similar increases in white blood cell counts in the targeted popliteal lymph node and liver as direct electrical sciatic nerve stimulation, though effects on the spleen and contralateral lymph node were attenuated compared with electrical stimulation.

exposures.label: Ultrasound neurostimulation directly above the popliteal lymph node

timing.protocol_description: An ultrasound stimulus was applied directly above the popliteal lymph node using the peripheral pFUS device, with total duration of a single stimulus not surpassing a single 1-min pulse; WBC/neutrophil/lymphocyte counts were compared with and without (sham CTRL) this stimulation.

source_quotes.n_subjects: with and without (sham CTRL) an ultrasound-induced nerve stimulation directly above the popliteal lymph node. N = 6.
source_quotes.anaesthesia: For ultrasound stimulation, animals were anesthetized with 2–4% isoflurane and laid on a water circulating warming pad to prevent hyperthermia during the procedure.
